correctness.rationale: Each asserted orbit is verified directly from its ternary expansion. Minimality is genuinely finite: every start \(1\le n<4096\) is iterated by an exact arithmetic implementation until repetition, and the only starts lying on their resulting cycles are \(36,64,72,144,288,1152\). All starts repeat within eight steps and no trajectory in the census exceeds \(41472\). The separate direct check proves that \(4096,10368,4608\) are distinct and form a 3-cycle.

value.rationale: The focal paper identifies cycle classification as one of the basic dynamical questions and leaves the \(t=2\) case without such a description. The least non-fixed cycle and the least period-\(3\) cycle are natural exact invariants of this first unresolved shifted ternary map, not arbitrary bounded examples. The result also provides a compact regression benchmark for future unconditional work on \(S_{2,3}\): any proposed classification must contain exactly the six periodic points below \(4096\) and the displayed first 3-cycle.
